TotalEnergies, Mistral Partner to Develop AI Models for Reservoir Exploration, Engineering

TotalEnergies and Mistral plan to invest more than 100 million euros ($115.5 million) in a program to develop frontier artificial intelligence models to support TotalEnergies in the exploration, characterization and development of oil and gas reservoirs.

The joint three-year program between the French companies will develop new AI models that can integrate, process and interpret large volumes of data to generate scenarios for developing exploration opportunities for TotalEnergies. It will also optimize and extend the life of existing projects, TotalEnergies said Tuesday.
As part of the program, TotalEnergies and AI startup Mistral will establish a joint scientific laboratory to develop solutions tailored to the French energy company.
